sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Test setup
sections.what: Imports the hashing and file tools, the test tools, and the check builder. Reads the saved file from a fixed relative path.

sections.name: offline doubly robust check of scenario estimates (dr)
sections.title: Reproducibility and disagreement checks
sections.what: Checks the file hash and that a fresh build equals the saved file. Checks that the logged decisions add up, that the disagreement numbers match the difference between the estimates, that each interval is in order, and that the note and status say the result is exploratory.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps the result honest and checkable.
sections.watch_out: The wording of the note is tested. Keep the exploratory status unless the method has been validated.

summary: Checks a saved offline doubly robust comparison of pace and spin scenario estimates for IPL death overs, confirms it can be rebuilt from committed data, and confirms it is labelled exploratory.
purpose: Makes sure the death-over comparison is reproducible and is never presented as what would have happened.
why: The comments say this is run on real IPL death-over data with the model:dr script. The explicit note text shows the intent to avoid overclaiming.
how: Loads the JSON, checks its hash, rebuilds it with buildDrCheck and compares the result. Then checks that logged decisions equal pace plus spin, that the disagreement arithmetic and intervals are consistent, and that the note and status say exploratory.
risks: The full rebuild comparison fails for any small change in data or code. The exploratory label must stay in place unless the method is validated.
debug: If the rebuild fails, compare the saved file with a fresh build. If the hash fails, check whether the file was edited by hand.
